strategy: Focus on War Plans activities such as Helltides, Undercity of Kurast, or the Pit while progressing difficulty as gear improves. Prioritize constantly upgrading weapons (one-handed priority for Frenzy), temper regular gear early, and clear Strongholds near level 60 for experience boosts before transitioning to endgame at level 70.
